checks.requirement: **Low-friction onboarding.** A new candidate reaches a reviewed master record and a first prepared packet by conversation and import, with few interventions
checks.evidence_required: Fresh install on a clean machine, fictional persona, run end to end. Counts of user turns, repeated questions, manual edits and rescues. Time and calls. Variance across repeats
checks.falsifier: A required step needs a hand-edited file. The same settled fact is unnecessarily requested again; an explicit candidate-only confirmation is not a redundant factual question. Onboarding assumes a field, degree or career stage. Interventions are not measured
checks.review_note: Baseline finding: live profile assistant moves to summarizing after 2-4 stories (all 11 transcripts; ending joint with the scripted candidate) (coverage of all facts 0.33-0.6); conversation-built runs pass 2/9 vs seeded 9/9.

checks.requirement: **Durable candidate memory.** Facts with provenance, contradictions and unknowns, preferences, voice and taste, several writing samples, strengths and constraints. Editable and deletable. Survives restart and a provider switch. Sharing controls. Approved corrections reused later. No invented identity
checks.evidence_required: Restart and provider-switch test on memory contents. Edit and delete tests with downstream effect. A planted contradiction is surfaced, not silently resolved. An approved correction changes a later packet. An excluded source leaves provider context and clears approvals
checks.falsifier: Memory differs after restart or provider switch. A deleted fact still appears in a packet. A contradiction is resolved without the candidate. A fact has no source. Identity detail appears that no source holds
checks.review_note: M2 (factual-source gate) and M1 (lossless export/import with approval reset, autonomy off, held unverifiable answers, atomic recovery) integrated; root probes confirm restart/provider-switch persistence and the five-key import loss closed. Open: M3 story edit/delete, M4 approved-correction reuse in drafting, M5 contradictions, real-model contribution.

checks.requirement: **Master completeness.** The master record is complete and canonical. The master resume is derived from it, inspectable, with no length limit, and lists what it missed
checks.evidence_required: Multi-role, multi-stage fictional personas with older roles, certifications and a career gap. Check each source role, result and credential appears in the master or is listed as missing. Tailoring leaves the master byte-identical
checks.falsifier: A source role, result or credential is silently absent. The master adds an unsupported line. Tailoring changes the master. The old standard resume is treated as current without a flag
checks.review_note: Continuation integrated: master resume replaces standard; heading now part of approval identity and visible. Lexical masterCoverage and 150-entry cap remain measured gaps; no multi-role persona run.

checks.requirement: **Per-job relevance and order.** Each tailored resume selects and orders for the job and keeps older relevant roles
checks.evidence_required: Paired jobs with the same persona where the right selection differs. Held-out cases. Scored selection and order, plus an old-but-relevant role planted. Judge on relevance with quote validation
checks.falsifier: An older role that matches the job is dropped. An irrelevant role leads. A pre-specified pair requiring different evidence produces the same selection despite the documented relevance difference. Selection is correct only because the job vocabulary was copied
checks.review_note: Per-job selection/order mechanism merged with continuation (f366946); no root-run paired or held-out evidence yet, so the row stays not_run. Baseline finding: tailoring keeps reverse-chronological order; old relevant role does not lead (2 of 6 held-out); judge structure ~3.4/5. Owner decision 2026-11-15 (how tailoring should work): from the master record, keep only the experience relevant to the job and drop the rest; curate each kept role's lines to the role; order the kept roles newest first by default, or with the strongest match on top when the candidate chooses that (a per-candidate setting). Cover letter: a concise restatement of the strongest matches in the resume (owner to double-check this convention). Note: the frozen leadShare check encodes 'old relevant role leads'; under this decision it holds only when the newer roles are irrelevant and dropped, so scorer v2 must check order against the candidate's chosen setting.

checks.requirement: **Voice and conversational revision.** Several writing samples shape voice. "Shorter", "lead with X" revise a packet by conversation and re-run review
checks.evidence_required: Revision tests that re-run factual review and rendering. Synthetic contrastive voice samples as the local substitute. User voice validation is external (see External checks)
checks.falsifier: A revision breaks a verified claim. Revision skips review. Output ignores the sample. A synthetic result is reported as user-voice acceptance

checks.requirement: **Grounded reusable answers with uncertainty.** Answers cite sources, flag what is unsettled, and are reused. No repeated question when sources settle it
checks.evidence_required: Repeat-question counter over a multi-application run. Planted settled and unsettled facts. Answers given to flagged fields offered to the answer bank
checks.falsifier: A settled non-sensitive fact is unnecessarily asked again. An unsettled fact is answered without a flag. An answer cannot be traced to a source. A sensitive answer is reused without the candidate

checks.requirement: **Packet fidelity.** Truthful CV, resume, cover letter and answers. Reviewed packet. Real rendered PDF text, layout and ATS checks
checks.evidence_required: Independent claim check with validated source quotes. Planted unsupported claims are caught (negative controls). Real PDF text extraction, layout and ATS-parse checks against rendered files
checks.falsifier: A planted unsupported claim passes. A PDF drops or reorders text. The reviewed packet differs from what is attached. Claim numbers are matched without the source
checks.review_note: Production calibration attributes each posting number per occurrence (continuation fix plus root ownership-after rule revised per independent DeepSeek review: interest/intent is not ownership, clause ends at the next number). Residual: appositive leak ("a team I built"). Scorer counterexamples, real PDF fidelity and independent factual acceptance remain open. Scorer now grounds numbers per mention (posting never pooled), scans headings, and requires real rendered-PDF text/geometry evidence (pdfjs+Poppler); magic-byte pass removed. Controlled 44/46, 0 unexpected. No live or human-calibrated evidence.

checks.requirement: **Application and site paths.** Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby measured separately; Workday best effort with handoff; LinkedIn and Indeed save, prepare and manual kit; unsupported sites never block preparation. Form fill ends in a user review with provenance for each field. Never submits
checks.evidence_required: Real-browser DOM readback and upload-hash check per supported ATS on local realistic forms and owned portals. Manual-kit run on an unsupported site with tracking intact. False-ready, sensitive-field and unauthorized-submission detectors with planted failures. Access tier recorded per run: local fixture, offline capture, or real-site read-only
checks.falsifier: A field is filled without recorded provenance. A sensitive field is auto-filled. A submit control is clicked. Ready is reported while the DOM disagrees. An unsupported site blocks packet creation. A fixture result is cited as real-site support
checks.review_note: Three controlled portal shapes exercised at 8012a83, DOM upload hashes/readback matched and no sensitive fills. All shapes share synthetic Lever host; separate ATS host paths, manual kit and real-site tiers remain unverified.

checks.requirement: **Quality-preserving queues and autonomy.** Batches and queues, resume, retry, cancel, opt-in autonomy within limits
checks.evidence_required: Interrupt-and-resume, per-item retry and cancel tests. Daily limit honored. Packet quality in a queued run compared with a single run on the same inputs
checks.falsifier: Repeated paired runs exceed the frozen quality-regression bound; a single stochastic difference is not sufficient evidence. A limit is exceeded. Autonomy is on by default. Cancel leaves a confirmable action. A restart loses queue state

checks.requirement: **Tracking and learning.** Tracker, contacts, calendar, imports and exports, follow-ups, outcome recommendations
checks.evidence_required: Round-trip import and export. Stage board, contact roll-up, calendar and CSV from the unmerged branches, re-tested. Follow-ups cite the submitted packet. Recommendations remain candidates until approved and show insufficient data
checks.falsifier: A follow-up is marked sent without the candidate. Insufficient data is shown as a rate. A recommendation changes configuration unapproved. An import corrupts the tracker
checks.review_note: Tracking increment integrated at 9ec623777e1c77157b975a1f92e07175babaa0f4; root export/cloud/local Chromium checks passed. U10 round-trip/follow-up/outcome acceptance still incomplete; hosted browser unverified.

checks.requirement: **Privacy, approval and injection safety.** Candidate-only decisions, stale evidence invalidates approvals, tainted content cannot escalate
checks.evidence_required: Adversarial postings and notes. Approval invalidated by a changed source or exclusion. Tier checks mutation-tested. Provider-context contents inspected. No user data in tracked files
checks.falsifier: Posting text causes an unconfirmed write or tier escalation. An approval survives a changed source. Contact detail reaches a provider by default. A candidate-only action runs from an agent

checks.requirement: **Release-quality product.** UI and CLI parity and reachability, fresh install, export and import, historical capability parity and status reconciliation, hosted optional, adjacent-work inventory
checks.evidence_required: Reachability matrix for each capability across its intended screen, conversation, CLI and MCP surfaces, with explicit tier restrictions and documented unsupported interfaces. Browser review in light, dark and mobile layouts, keyboard/focus checks, and readable field provenance; existing CLI workflows remain usable. Fresh clone `setup` then `start`. Workspace export and import into a new workspace. Each row of the VERIFICATION-MATRIX re-checked against current code and marked carried, re-run or retired. Inventory of interview prep, fit and discovery, email status suggestions, learning plan, listing what exists and its evidence
checks.falsifier: An intended consumer cannot reach a capability, an existing supported workflow regresses, or a candidate-only action becomes agent-callable. Required visual/browser evidence is missing. A fresh install needs undocumented steps. Import loses data. A historical PASS is carried over with no current evidence. Hosted is required for any row
checks.review_note: P2 inventory independently reviewed; direct import key-loss probe confirms incomplete round-trip. Reachability, fresh install and current built UI evidence remain open. Local import now lossless and atomic (M1); hosted transfer tests not run (no DB).

checks.requirement: **Evaluation harness and independent measurement.** Pre-registered, repeatable, independent of the builder
checks.review_note: Measurement audit has reproducible false-pass counterexamples. No frozen design or live baseline yet; independent judging and human calibration remain open. Scorer validity fixes integrated (numeric laundering, headings, real PDF evidence); baseline not yet frozen; live budget awaits owner. Baseline frozen 2026-11-15 (docs/internal/baseline/BASELINE-MANIFEST.json): 59 scenarios incl. held-out old-role, borderline and STEM pair; two independent reviews applied. Live Codex run and Claude judge pending; judge uncalibrated. Live baseline run at 00ce1bf (Codex, Claude judge uncalibrated): 344/900 calls; results docs/internal/baseline/BASELINE-RESULTS.md. Two scorer defects found by the run (PDF order false positive on repeated wording; honest zero-match Skip fails). Model identity unrecorded (familyProof catalog-only); third-round scorer edits unreviewed.

checks.requirement: **Quota efficiency at volume.** A candidate on an ordinary subscription can prepare many applications per quota window, not one or two. Model calls, tokens and wall time per application are measured per provider and reduced without losing quality
checks.evidence_required: Per-application calls, input/output/reasoning tokens and wall time recorded for every live run (baseline first). Quota consumed per application, given as a share of the provider's subscription window where it can be measured. A leaner pipeline compared with the frozen baseline on the same scenarios: equal or better quality scores, fewer calls or tokens
checks.falsifier: Cost per application is not measured, or is estimated without run data. A cost cut lowers a quality or grounding score. A typical subscription window covers only one or two applications and no reduction is planned
checks.review_note: Added 2026-11-15 at owner request. Owner chose Codex for the live baseline; the baseline must record usage so this row has a starting figure. Starting figure (baseline 00ce1bf): seeded application 5 calls/121k input tokens; conversation-built 11 calls/280k; journey 15 calls/374k. Codex-reported input ~25k tokens per call (includes CLI overhead; Plainhand share unmeasured). Cached/reasoning tokens dropped by the runner, not measured; model unrecorded.

checks.requirement: **Updates keep the candidate's setup.** A candidate moves to each new Plainhand version without restarting: profile, master resume, stories, applications, settings and provider sign-ins carry over. The update path is simple on the candidate's side and a repeatable release workflow on ours
checks.evidence_required: A real update from the previous release to the next on a populated install: every stored record and setting present and usable afterwards, with any data migration run automatically and reversible. The candidate-side steps written out and timed. The release steps on our side written down and run once end to end
checks.falsifier: Any profile, story, application, setting or sign-in is lost or needs re-entry after an update. An update needs manual file copying or a fresh setup. There is no written release procedure, or a migration cannot be rolled back
checks.review_note: Added 2026-11-15 at owner request. Deferred by the owner until the current work (tailoring, profile conversation, quota) is finished. Not started.
